vars.CONTRACT_CHANGE_NOTE: quota_notice() returns a structured dict with keys 'rps' and 'per_minute'. The old single-string form was retired deliberately so the notice banner could pluralize per locale.
vars.DECISION_TEXT: Should the launch webinar be run live or pre-recorded? Live gets questions answered and feels current; pre-recorded lets us re-run it in three time zones without staffing it three times. This is a go-to-market call, not a technical one.
